title: limonium bungei
intro: Limonium bungei, commonly known as Bunge's sea lavender, is a plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Limonium bungei are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which may help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
